tools.name: get_catalog_filters
tools.description: Read public ALSER.kz catalog filters, price range, promotions, product types, and sort options for a category using the same mobapi-v3 catalog endpoint as the site category page. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

category_keyword.description: Public category keyword from the catalog URL, for example smartfony.

location_id.description: ALSER city/location id. Defaults to Almaty if not provided.

only_local.description: Whether to calculate filters for local city availability only.

tools.name: get_catalog_products
tools.description: Read public ALSER.kz catalog products for a category using the same mobapi-v3 catalog endpoint as the site category page. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

category_keyword.description: Public category keyword from the catalog URL, for example smartfony.

location_id.description: ALSER city/location id. Defaults to Almaty if not provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

sort.description: Optional sort id supported by the catalog response.

filters.description: Optional filters in catalog URL form: { filter_keyword: [option_keyword] }.

types.description: Optional product type keywords from get_catalog_filters.types.

only_local.description: Whether to return only local city availability.

with_specs.description: Whether to request product specs in the catalog response.

tools.name: get_catalog_tree
tools.description: Read the public ALSER.kz catalog category tree using the same catalog-full endpoint as the site header catalog. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

location_id.description: ALSER city/location id. Defaults to Almaty if not provided.

max_depth.description: Maximum category nesting depth to return.

include_images.description: Whether to include public category image URLs.

tools.name: get_cities
tools.description: Read the public list of ALSER.kz cities available for delivery and pickup, with the codes other tools expect (city_code for get_shops, location_id for get_product_detail/list_promos/get_catalog_products/etc). This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

limit.description: Maximum number of cities to return.

tools.name: get_homepage_blocks
tools.description: Read public ALSER.kz homepage blocks: product of the day, sale, best sellers, new products, popular products, popular categories, and articles. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

location_id.description: ALSER city/location id. Defaults to Almaty if not provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per homepage product/article block.

tools.name: get_product_detail
tools.description: Read public ALSER.kz product price, availability, delivery terms, specifications, and optional extended details by sku or product keyword. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

sku.description: Product SKU. Either sku or keyword is required.

keyword.description: Product URL keyword. Either sku or keyword is required.

location_id.description: ALSER city/location id. Defaults to Almaty if not provided.

include_images.description: Whether to include public product images.

include_description.description: Whether to load the full public product description as HTML.

include_reviews.description: Whether to load public product reviews.

reviews_limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return when include_reviews is true.

include_store_availability.description: Whether to load product availability in stores.

city_code.description: Optional FO city code for store availability. If omitted, it is resolved from location_id.

tools.name: get_promo_products
tools.description: Read public ALSER.kz products attached to a promotion by promotion keyword. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

location_id.description: ALSER city/location id. Defaults to Almaty if not provided.

category_id.description: Optional public category id to limit promotion products.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

tools.name: get_shops
tools.description: Read public ALSER.kz shop pickup points by city code. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

city_code.description: FO city code. Defaults to Almaty.

limit.description: Maximum number of shops to return.

tools.name: list_promos
tools.description: Read public ALSER.kz promotions for a city/location. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

location_id.description: ALSER city/location id. Defaults to Almaty if not provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of promotions to return.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search public ALSER.kz products by a text query. This tool is read-only and returns only public site data.

query.description: Search text, for example a product name, brand, SKU, or category phrase.

category_keyword.description: Optional public category keyword to limit search context.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.
